schema_note: Field order in this artifact is NORMATIVE (deterministic field order; reviewers diff artifacts textually). A change to ANY field — an added, removed, or re-parameterised case, a new fixture version, a changed solver pin — is a NEW version id (flexcore-research-benchmark-set-v2, ...), frozen as a NEW file. This file is never edited in place after freeze.

anti_silent_growth_rule: A benchmark change is a NEW version. This mirrors the P8.06 frozen-baseline discipline (a baseline change is a new baseline version, never a silent edit) and the P8.05 HARNESS_VERSION discipline. Every Phase 8 evaluation (P8.06 baseline runs, P8.09, P8.12, P8.15, P8.21, P8.23) cites exactly ONE version id — this one for the v1 freezes. An evaluation whose cited version differs from the artifact it claims to use is a named finding, never absorbed.
run_status_note: NOTHING in this set has been RUN. The workspace has never been built or executed (P8.01 G-1: the deterministic baseline's benchmark numbers do not exist; the P3.27/P5 benchmark tables carry not_measured/EMPTY cells). Every run_status below is NOT_RUN and every pre-registered expected outcome is UNRUN. The human/lab build-and-run gate produces run evidence in the evaluation records that cite this version id — a filled run never edits this artifact.

parameters.pv_ramp: PV down 80 percent of clear-sky inside 12:00-13:00 UTC
parameters.stressor_location: the FORECAST, not the telemetry — telemetry stays all-GOOD and byte-identical to scenario (a)'s

parameters.forecast_error: PV down 80 percent of clear-sky inside 12:00-13:00 UTC (the error fixture differs from forecast-fixture-v1.json only in the error plan)

research_case_additions.stressor: communication loss (§19.3 bullet 5) — PARTIAL MAPPING, stated honestly
research_case_additions.source: scenarios/synthetic-portfolio/scenarios-phase3/scenario-c-dropout.json (v1) + the P5.21 fault-injection suite (apps/sim-runner/src/fault_injection.rs — dropped/reordered/duplicated messages, §19.2(6)) + lib-04 (worker-timeout analogue at the worker boundary)

parameters.telemetry_dropout_window_utc: 12:00-13:00 (no frames reach the platform for the window — the recorded communication-loss analogue at the telemetry layer, per the lib-07 record)
parameters.full_fault_set: owned by the P5.21 injection suite, not by a dedicated benchmark case

research_case_additions.honest_limit: there is NO dedicated sustained-communication-loss benchmark case in this set; the dropout window and the fault-injection suite are the recorded analogues — see not-tested item NT-7

parameters.expected_gap: the gap is an EXPECTED gap (the P2.25 expected-quality plan pre-registers MISSING / expected_gap)
parameters.roll: the prior-schedule roll pin is enabled so the REAL P3.24 rolling roll fires in the run record

parameters.dispatch_target: +1.5 MW EXPORT at the connection point (P > 0 = export, §10.2/P0.07)

research_case_additions.honest_limit: on the scripted backend the grid check is the recorded FIXTURE outcome and passes — the scripted backend CANNOT produce a reverse-power-flow violation (recorded honestly in the lib-08 record); the violation expectation is pre-registered for the worker_process leg, UNRUN
research_case_additions.backend: scripted (limitation recorded) / worker_process leg (UNVERIFIED pandapower API)

research_case_additions.stressor: topology change (§19.3 bullet 5) — PARTIAL MAPPING, stated honestly
research_case_additions.source: the meshed two-feeder synthetic fixture (model_id synthetic-meshed-two-feeder, version 1)

parameters.coverage: topology-CLASS variation (radial lib-01/lib-02 vs balanced meshed lib-03) at fixture scale — per the lib-08 record's own statement: 'a fixture-level topology class, not a runtime switching model'

research_case_additions.honest_limit: a RUNTIME topology-change event (feeder switching / line trip mid-horizon in the quasi-static grid model) is NOT implemented in this repository — see not-tested item NT-6
